laws.name: Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act
requires: general description of benefits and other compensation
laws.remote: Covers remote jobs that could be performed in Colorado.

laws.name: California SB 1162 (Labor Code 432.3)
requires: pay scale (salary or hourly range the employer reasonably expects to pay)
laws.remote: Covers remote jobs that could be performed in California.

laws.name: Washington Equal Pay and Opportunities Act
requires: general description of all benefits and other compensation
laws.remote: Covers remote jobs that could be filled by a Washington worker.

laws.name: New York State Labor Law 194-b
laws.remote: Covers jobs performed at least partly in New York or reporting to a New York supervisor or site.

laws.name: New York City Pay Transparency Law
requires: minimum and maximum salary or hourly rate
laws.remote: Covers remote jobs that could be performed in NYC.

laws.name: Jersey City pay transparency ordinance
laws.remote: Unclear; treat as covered if the role could be done there.

laws.name: Ithaca pay transparency ordinance
laws.remote: Unclear.

laws.name: Westchester County pay transparency law
laws.remote: Unclear.

laws.name: Hawaii Act 203 (2023)
laws.remote: Unclear.

laws.name: DC Wage Transparency Omnibus Amendment Act
requires: healthcare benefits disclosed before the first interview
laws.remote: Covers jobs performed in DC.

laws.name: Maryland Wage Range Transparency Act
requires: general description of benefits and other compensation
laws.remote: Covers jobs performed at least partly in Maryland.

laws.name: Illinois Equal Pay Act amendments (HB 3129)
requires: general description of benefits (or a hyperlink to them)
laws.remote: Covers jobs performed at least partly in Illinois or reporting to an Illinois supervisor or site.

laws.name: Minnesota pay transparency law
requires: general description of benefits and other compensation
laws.remote: Unclear.

laws.name: New Jersey pay transparency law (S2310)
requires: general description of benefits and other compensation
laws.remote: Unclear.

laws.name: Vermont Act 155 (2024)
laws.remote: Covers remote jobs that predominantly serve a Vermont office.

laws.name: Massachusetts Frances Perkins Workplace Equity Act
laws.remote: Covers jobs performed primarily in Massachusetts.

laws.name: Cleveland pay transparency ordinance
requires: salary range or scale (salary includes benefits)
laws.remote: Unclear.

laws.name: Virginia pay transparency law (2026)
requires: good-faith wage, salary or range in public and internal postings
laws.remote: Unclear.

laws.name: Maine pay transparency law (2026)
requires: state if the job is commission-only
laws.remote: Unclear.

laws.name: Connecticut Public Act 26-12
requires: good-faith pay range in public and internal postings
laws.remote: Covers jobs performed in Connecticut or reporting to a Connecticut supervisor or site.

laws.name: Columbus pay transparency ordinance
requires: reasonable pay range in external postings
laws.remote: Only jobs performed within the city.

laws.name: Delaware pay transparency law (2025)
laws.remote: Covers Delaware jobs and US-remote jobs offered by Delaware-based employers.

laws.name: Ontario Working for Workers Act (pay transparency)
requires: expected pay or range (range no wider than $50,000)
laws.remote: Unclear.

laws.name: British Columbia Pay Transparency Act
